title: Why We Waited 13 Years for GTA 6
description:
Why did GTA 6 take 13 years? GTA 5 came out in 2013. Then Rockstar put its studios together on one giant western, Red Dead Redemption 2, which took until 2018. Meanwhile GTA 5 kept selling: more than 200 million copies. When the first GTA 6 trailer dropped in 2023, it got 93 million views in a single day. Then GTA 6 was delayed twice, to May 2026 and then to November 19, 2026.

Was GTA 6 worth the wait? Tell us below.

More true whys: https://www.youtube.com/@truewhys?sub_confirmation=1

Sources: Rockstar Newswire (release date, Nov 2025); Take-Two earnings reports via PC Gamer and GamingBolt (GTA 5 sales); Wikipedia, "Development of Red Dead Redemption 2".
